capabilities: Import a local TBX or XML term file
Select source and target xml:lang labels
Preview terms, alternate forms and definitions
Create a glossary table note with skipped and missing records
Merge a later term file against a prior glossary note
disambiguation: Not a general TBX converter; it only imports supported TBX v2 records and refuses TBX v3, DTD or ENTITY declarations.
extras: Freemium: single-file import is free; batch import (up to 20 files) and merge review require a $5/month or one-time $15 GitHub Sponsors payment. After updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat. README states mobile devices, other OSes and commercial terminology tool exports were not tested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn local TBX terminology files into a two-language glossary table inside a note.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Imports a local TBX term base and creates a bilingual glossary note with a Markdown table and a report of skipped or missing records.
